newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's CRT started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's CRT started.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Mickey Schleien started coverage of Brazilian telephone company Companhia Riograndense de Telecomunicacoes, or CRT, Wednesday with a rating of buy.

-- CRT, the local carrier in Brazil's Rio Grande do Sul state, is controlled by Spain's Telefonica de Espana. Telefonica last week joined a telecom alliance with the United States' MCI Communications Corp and British Telecommunications Plc.
-- The analyst set a price target of $160 a share and praised the company's relatively low valuation. The stock trades on Brazil's over-the-counter market, the SOMA.
-- The shares were up three reais to 135 in early afternoon trade.
